reason: The Atlas/world-culture course direction is clear, but the exact Traveler's Atlas source corpus has not yet been recovered and reconciled into current Rex Fleet canon. Do not invent production pages merely to establish an issue count.
scope: Shard worlds, havens, trade and survival cultures
routes, ports, markets and travel assumptions
issueCountPolicy: Open. Let the recovered Atlas corpus and distinct world/culture subjects determine the eventual number and size of issues.

sourceNeeds: Locate the exact Traveler's Atlas source text/edition referenced in prior worldbuilding.
